_about: Catalogue sentences Sidekick must not quote, after a human read-through. Add the first few words of a sentence to 'drop' and run `npm run sidekick:train`. Sentences are matched from their start, ignoring case and punctuation.
drop: Improves hole finish due to better lubrication

_why.Due to the 5% Cobalt content: True of the Super (M35) jobber drill only; the product page also covers the M2 versions.
_why.Self centering split point: Super jobber drills only, same reason.
_why.Improves hole finish due to better lubri: From the Gold drill page and has no subject; the product page covers three versions.
_why.K05 Tip grade is suitable: From the carbide grade chart, which applies to every carbide-tipped tool rather than one product.
